note: Hotjar injects the Hotjar analytics JS snippet, controlled entirely by the hotjar.settings config object (account = Hotjar ID; visibility_pages 0=all-except-listed/1=only-listed/2=none; pages; visibility_roles; roles; attachment_mode build|drupal_settings). Hotjar is an EXTERNAL service, so all cases are grounded in the LOCAL config, not in live tracking behaviour. Baseline (config/install) = account '', visibility_pages 0, default pages list, attachment_mode build. Medium cases set a known account / visibility and read it back; hard cases reset to a known baseline (verify FAILS) and require the agent to set the target config. cleanup restores shipped defaults.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Hotjar Drupal module. Where do I enter my Hotjar ID, which config object stores it, and does anything get output before I set it?
evals.expected_output: Enter the Hotjar ID on the settings form at /admin/config/system/hotjar (route hotjar.admin_settings_form, permission 'administer hotjar'). It is stored as hotjar.settings.account. Nothing is output until account is non-empty.

evals.prompt: In the Hotjar module, what does the visibility_pages setting control and what do its values mean?
evals.expected_output: visibility_pages controls page-based visibility against the 'pages' list: 0 = add tracking to every page EXCEPT the listed pages; 1 = add it ONLY to the listed pages; 2 = do not add it anywhere. Tracking is also always suppressed on 403/404 responses.

evals.prompt: The Hotjar module has an attachment_mode setting. What are the two modes and how do they differ in how the snippet is delivered?
evals.expected_output: build (default): the activation script is written to a JS file at snippet_path (public://hotjar/hotjar.script.js) and added as a <script src> in the head. drupal_settings: the ID/version are passed via drupalSettings and the hotjar/hotjar library runs it.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has Hotjar configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the Hotjar ID (account) currently set.
On this site, Hotjar has been restricted to only certain pages. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the page-visibility mode and which pages the tracking is limited to.
evals.expected_output: visibility_pages is 1 (track ONLY the listed pages) and the pages list is /landing and /promo (hotjar.settings.visibility_pages = 1, pages = /landing, /promo).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Hotjar module so the site is tracked under Hotjar ID 7654321. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set hotjar.settings.account to 7654321 (via the settings form at /admin/config/system/hotjar or drush config).

evals.prompt: I only want the Hotjar tracking to run on my landing page at /landing and nowhere else. Configure the Hotjar module on this site to do that.
evals.expected_output: Set hotjar.settings.visibility_pages to 1 (only listed pages) and set pages to include /landing.
